_doc: Figures for the printable Medicare cost reference card. EVERY value must be verified against medicare.gov and carry its source. CMS publishes next year's numbers in late Oct/early Nov — update 'year', the values, and 'verified' then, and the card becomes the new edition automatically. Do NOT pre-fill a future year with estimates.

rows.partD_cap: $2,100 a year, then you pay nothing more for covered drugs
rows.partD_deductible_max: No plan may charge more than $615
rows.partD_base_premium: $38.99 a month (used to figure late penalties)
